articles.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
articles.summary: The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

articles.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
articles.summary: Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.

articles.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
articles.summary: Runlayer is suing Rippling after Rippling evaluated the startup's MCP gateway product and then opted to build one itself.

articles.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
articles.summary: Since launching last year, the startup today has more than 8 million people using the open source or hosted version of its models, and now generates annual recurring revenue of $21 million.

articles.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
articles.summary: Recursive’s emphasis on self-improving AI systems means much of the budget that would traditionally go toward headcount and operations is put straight into compute, as the company seeks to automate its own product development process.

articles.title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
articles.summary: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.

articles.title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
articles.summary: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.

articles.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
articles.summary: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

articles.title: Microsoft launches its first cybersecurity model, plus a new agentic cybersecurity system

articles.title: OpenAI’s Hugging Face breach has reignited the debate over alignment and control
articles.summary: OpenAI's Hugging Face breach has reignited debate over AI alignment and control, exposing competing views on whether increasingly capable AI should be better aligned, better contained, or both.

articles.title: Threads users can now chat with Meta AI in their DMs
articles.summary: Meta on Monday said it is rolling out its Meta AI chatbot within Threads' DMs, giving users a way to chat with the AI assistant.

articles.title: Google’s AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
articles.summary: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.

articles.title: Power up your AI infrastructure! A first look at the Smart Systems Stage agenda at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Smart Systems Stage will be where energy, infrastructure, and technology collide, covering everything from fusion breakthroughs to the grid strain AI is putting on the entire economy.

articles.title: This $9 key physically locks your most addictive apps

articles.summary: Though no cause has been given as of yet

articles.title: 30-MW Nebraska microgrid gets a non-lithium battery boost
articles.summary: Lincoln Electric System is energizing a 3-MW/12-MWh zinc-based battery to support the Nebraska state Capitol complex and other critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Behind the New York data center pause is legislation that could impact existing facilities
articles.summary: Legislation that’s been put on the back burner while the moratorium is in effect would require large data centers to procure at least a third of their electricity from renewable sources by 2030 and might impact those with water-intensive cooling, analyses show.

articles.title: Community solar can bridge California’s energy affordability gap
articles.summary: Regulatory complexities are thwarting innovation and keeping electricity bills for the majority of Californians far too high, writes Ardi Arian, CEO of Renewable America.

articles.title: PJM board proposes backstop capacity auction, data center curtailment plans
articles.summary: FERC’s response to the proposals will likely “influence utility capital investment, data center development timelines and the allocation of reliability risks and costs,” ClearView Energy Partners said.

articles.title: BNEF chip-based model pegs US data center demand at 207 GW by 2033
articles.summary: A base model anticipates U.S. data center demand of about 118 GW by 2030. As potential demand and proposed data center size both grow, so does the complexity in forecasting, analysts said.

articles.title: CenterPoint says 14 GW likely eligible for Texas’ ‘Batch Zero’ large-load interconnection
articles.summary: The utility expects 50% load growth by the end of 2029, largely driven by data centers navigating Texas’ new large-load interconnection process, company officials said Tuesday.

articles.title: Utility profits in the crosshairs amid affordability concerns
articles.summary: As states target utilities’ return on equity, Pepco’s rate case in Maryland, where the consumer advocate is arguing for an ROE cut, is being closely watched.

articles.title: States cannot be granted filing rights under Section 205 of the Federal Power Act
articles.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission should reject a proposal that states share “filing rights” with the PJM Interconnection and its transmission owners, former FERC Chairman Joseph Kelliher writes.

articles.title: Trump’s ‘vindictive’ use of energy, other grants sparks backlash
articles.summary: The administration nixed $7.6 billion in clean energy grants last year “based solely on the political identity of the grant recipient’s state,” the U.S Department of Energy said in court documents.

articles.title: NextEra on track to close Dominion merger by late 2027, executives say
articles.summary: The Virginia State Corporation Commission has scheduled the first public hearing on the proposal for this November. Separately, NextEra is also working to sign final agreements with the U.S. and Japan for 9.5 GW of gas-fired “hubs” in Texas and Pennsylvania.

articles.title: Siting licence granted for new Kola nuclear power plant units
articles.summary: Russia's nuclear regulatory Rostekhnadzor has issued site licences for the first two proposed units at the new Kola Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: South Korean SMR-powered container ship design certified
articles.summary: The Korea Research Institute of Ships & Ocean Engineering has received Approval in Principle from the American Bureau of Shipping for the conceptual design of a container ship propelled by two small modular molten salt reactors.

articles.title: Bulgaria's planned AP1000s 'strategic bilateral priority'
articles.summary: Commitment to the on-going project to build two new units at the Kozloduy Nuclear Power Plant has been stressed in talks between senior Bulgarian and US representatives.

articles.title: Mochovce 4 preparing for physical start-up tests
articles.summary: Slovenské elektrárne has said the assembly and hermetic sealing of the reactor has been completed and Slovakia's Mochovce unit 4 is ready to move on to the physical tests leading to the first controlled fission reaction.

articles.title: Two more Czech sites lined up for Rolls-Royce SMRs
articles.summary: The Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade, ČEZ and Rolls-Royce SMR have signed a memorandum of understanding to start preparatory activities for small modular reactor projects at two more locations.

articles.title: Multiple MSRs proposed for French industrial park
articles.summary: French molten salt reactor developer Stellaria has signed a memorandum of understanding with Unitel Group and Energie Hub to develop an integrated energy hub in the Fos-sur-Mer area of southern France.

articles.title: Korean-US partnership for floating SMR platform
articles.summary: South Korean shipbuilding company Samsung Heavy Industries announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with USA-based engineering firm Sargent & Lundy for the development of a standardised floating small modular reactor platform.

articles.title: Nuclearelectrica's proposal to review SMR options rejected by ministry
articles.summary: Romania's state-owned nuclear company had asked shareholders to approve "the initiation of steps to reassess the initial development strategy for small modular reactors by expanding the analysis to include other SMR technologies and broadening the list of potential sites (in the event of a decision to scale up)".

articles.title: Landmark module installation at Lufeng 2
articles.summary: The CA01 'super module' has been installed at unit 2 of the Lufeng nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province, China General Nuclear announced.

articles.title: First port signs up to US initiative on maritime SMRs
articles.summary: The Port of Long Beach in California has become the first port in the USA to sign a memorandum of cooperation with the Department of Transportation's Maritime Administration to advance work on development of small modular reactor technology to power commercial vessels, ports and other maritime assets.

articles.title: UK start-up Nuclear Turbines unveils novel reactor concept
articles.summary: The spin-off from BAE Systems has raised GBP15 million (USD19.9 million) funding and emerged from stealth with a nuclear reactor design combined with high-temperature turbine technology, which it says will lead to lower energy costs.

articles.title: Initiative launched to bolster Italian nuclear supply chain
articles.summary: Italian power technology firm Ansaldo Energia and certification and engineering company RINA have agreed to support the development of the country's nuclear supply chain and enable companies to seize opportunities in the rapidly growing global nuclear market by guiding them through a structured certification pathway.

articles.title: EDF teams up with Technip Energies for EPR2 delivery
articles.summary: French engineering and technology company Technip Energies announced it has signed a strategic framework agreement with EDF to support execution, construction management, and delivery of EDF's EPR2 reactor construction programme.

articles.title: Newcleo sets out plan for US licensing of reactor
articles.summary: France-headquartered innovative nuclear energy company Newcleo has submitted a Regulatory Engagement Plan to the US Nuclear Regulatory Commission for the LFR-AS-200, the commercial 200 MWe version of its lead-cooled fast neutron reactor.

articles.title: IAEA condemns reported killing of chief engineer at Zaporizhzhia NPP
articles.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency said its Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi "condemns the reported incident which he says represents an unacceptable attack on the plant and its management, seriously threatening nuclear safety".

articles.title: Spanish regulator supports Almaraz licence extension
articles.summary: Spain's Nuclear Safety Council has issued a favourable report on the renewal of the operating licence for the two-unit Almaraz nuclear power plant. It says the plant meets the conditions to operate safely until June 2030.

articles.title: Newcleo advances MOX fuel licensing in France
articles.summary: France's nuclear safety regulator has published its opinion on the safety features proposed by Paris-headquartered innovative nuclear energy company Newcleo for its planned French mixed-oxide fuel facility, concluding that the provisions adopted by the company for its safety approach are satisfactory at this stage.

articles.title: Molten salt reactor gets US safety design approval
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy's approval of the Nuclear Safety Design Agreement for Natura Resources' demonstration reactor is a key milestone towards first deployment of the advanced, liquid-fuelled nuclear reactor at Abilene Christian University in Texas.

articles.title: Oklo cleared to start up test reactor
articles.summary: The US Department of Energy has granted authorisation to nuclear technology company Oklo to start up its Groves Isotope Test Reactor, located near Lockhart in Caldwell County, Texas.

articles.title: Peer review of floating nuclear plant 'ranks it on par with Russia's top units'
articles.summary: Rosatom has said that a two-week World Association of Nuclear Operators peer review mission to the Akademik Lomonosov floating power unit assessed it for compliance with global best practices.
